description: This file contains React hooks and classes for managing and displaying tips within the Notesnook application, including tip selection, rotation, and contextual tips.

classes.name: TipManager
classes.description: Manages the display and state of tips based on context, including initialization and retrieval of tips.

methods.name: useTip
methods.description: React hook that provides a tip based on context, with optional rotation and delay.

methods.name: TipManager.tip
methods.description: Retrieves a random tip for a given context, respecting tip state and whether the tip has been shown before.
